phase: D2 — Formal Local Energy Optimizer & Final Closure Verification
title: Formal Mathematical Receding-Horizon Energy Optimizer Implementation and Final Closure Verification

final_closure_verification.battery_terminal_condition: Terminal SOC target is unconstrained; terminal SOC is bounded only by normal SOC operating limits (20% <= SOC[24] <= 95%).
final_closure_verification.objective_timestep_scaling: VERIFIED: Objective coefficients and battery transition constraints in milp.py read dt from config and scale power terms by dt.
final_closure_verification.diesel_objective_semantics: MILP objective is a monetary composite optimization objective ($); evaluator reports physical diesel fuel consumption (Liters). Startup fuel = startup_cost / fuel_price = 6.0 L.
final_closure_verification.flexible_load_semantics: P_demand represents Base/Inflexible Station Demand; P_flex_sched represents Scheduled Flexible Load Consumption. Total Station Demand = P_base + P_flex_sched. Bus-bar consumption = P_served + P_flex_sched + P_chg. Zero double-counting.
final_closure_verification.mpc_receding_horizon_execution: VERIFIED: observe state -> forecast 24h -> optimize 24h -> execute 1st step -> update state -> repeat.

claim_hygiene.boundary_statement: Research validation and operational prototype validation are separate. The frozen research artifacts establish only the claims documented by their respective research protocols. D2 demonstrates that a local MILP mathematical optimizer can execute offline and pass physical constraint and integrity tests. D2 does not establish real-world forecasting or EMS performance.
claim_hygiene.demo_metrics_disclaimer: These metrics validate implementation/runtime behavior on the synthetic smoke-test scenario; they do not constitute empirical validation of POLARIS EMS performance under real station conditions.

physical_accounting.bus_bar_power_balance: P_solar_used + P_wind_used + P_dis + P_diesel - P_served - P_chg - P_flex == 0
physical_accounting.battery_transition: E[t+1] = E[t] + (eta_chg * P_chg - P_dis / eta_dis) * dt
